decisions.reason: As a dumper that builds directly on the firm's established engineering and service knowledge and still has a dedicated product page in 2024, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity and shows no sign of withdrawal.
This articulated construction dumper is close to the core offer, so the firm can readily refine and support it with existing know-how, and its continued full presentation suggests ongoing commitment.

Because the mine rescue vehicle is distant from the firm's established knowledge base and was de-emphasized from its own page to only a website mention by 2024, management would likely reallocate resources unless stronger learning and market traction emerge.
The compact telescopic loader builds on familiar product and customer knowledge, and its continued dedicated presentation indicates the firm sees enough potential to keep developing it.

The material lift is close to the firm's established capabilities and the reported large order and long-standing rental popularity provide strong evidence that the firm can commercialize and improve it successfully.

Although the underground mining loader is distant from the core range, the quantified heavy early use gives the firm valuable operational learning and a credible basis to continue rather than exit now.
